message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage. I had just settled in with a book when the lights flickered and went out. Instead of scrambling around like I usually do, I felt a little thrill of preparedness—thanks to my trusty flashlights and a fully charged power bank, I was ready! I grabbed my lantern and settled into my cozy corner, enjoying the soft glow while my phone stayed charged for a few late-night texts. 

It felt good to finally be the one who was prepared for once! Who knew a little planning could turn a blackout into a cozy evening? 

What’s your go-to tip for staying comfortable during power outages?
